The '''Cloud Lake District''' was a district within the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ussa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. Like the other districts in the city, its name came from the [[Cloud Lake|lake]] that it contained. Many of Ussa's small businesses were located within the district.
